'''Tofli Argala''' was a classical composer<ref name="ST">{{SW|url=news/slugthrowers-an-overview-of-popular-music-and-musicians-in-a-galaxy-far-far-away-part-1|series=Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref> from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="CWG:S" /> who was alive during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="ST" /> By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] Argala had composed "[[The Spring Symphony]]," a soft piece of [[Music/Legends|music]] which [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]], [[Senator/Legends|senator]] for the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], played when [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] visited him on Alderaan with the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. Amidala suspected that Organa played the piece after remembering that she had once claimed Argala was her favorite of Naboo's music makers and also because he knew how homesick she was.<ref name="CWG:S" /> At another point during the Clone Wars, Argala worked with fellow musicians [[Bongiovi]], [[Augara Jowil/Legends|Augara Jowil]] and the [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council/Legends|Naboo Royal Advisory Council]] [[Music Advisor/Legends|music Advisor]] [[Hela Brandes/Legends|Hela Brandes]] to persuade [[Beezar Pert/Legends|Beezar Pert]], another famed composer, to come out of retirement for a charity [[Theed Palace Plaza concert|concert]]. The concert was held in the [[Palace Plaza/Legends|Palace Plaza]] in the Naboo [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] and sold out, with all profits being used to support children orphaned by the Clone Wars on both sides of the conflict.<ref name="ST" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tofli Argala was first mentioned in ''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]'', a novel by [[Karen Miller]] which was released in [[2010]]. They received another mention in the first part of ''[[Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away]]'', an article released in [[2013]] on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]] and written by [[Edward M. Erdelac]]. In the article Tofli's name is misspelt as Toffi.
